snippet.title: Tomb Joe Trailer
snippet.description:
Take the role of full time adventurer Mr. Tomb Jones and stop the evil Nazi force from stealing valuable ancient artifacts! This adventure puzzle platformer is currently on Steam Greenlight!

Music is provided by  Hitchtone Music & Promotion
